title: A Thorn for the Veil
author: Emrys Coldharbour
blurb: Xanthe Oyelaran, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
